items: Materialized view of Kafka stream as a Key-Value store.
Filters BrakeEfficiency < 70% and stores occurrence counts.

Declaration: KTable<String, Long> trainDatum = trainData
    .filter((key, value) -> key.equalsIgnoreCase("BrakeEfficiency"))
    .filter((key, value) -> Long.parseLong(value) < 70)
    .groupBy((key, value) -> value, Grouped.with(Serdes.String(), Serdes.String()))
    .count(Materialized.as("breakdata"));
Lifecycle manager for Kafka Streams in Spring.

Required to get access to the KafkaStreams instance. @Autowired
StreamsBuilderFactoryBean factoryBean;

content.text: To process and expose train speed and brake efficiency data, particularly brake efficiency < 70%, through Kafka Streams and a REST API.

items: GET http://localhost:8082/breakdata/16 → Number of times brake efficiency was 16%.
Sender Console: Displays sent speed + brake data.
Receiver Console: Displays filtered brake data below 70%.
REST Response: Gives count for a specific brake efficiency (e.g., how many times "16%" occurred).
